_doc: Decorative layers. 'left'/'right' are the fixed sugarcane illustrations at the screen edges (components/parts/site-decor.php, gated by the 'site_decor' key in sections.json). 'leaves' is the drifting air layer behind every INNER page heading (components/parts/leaf-drift.php) - the front page is deliberately left clean, and the whole layer is removed under prefers-reduced-motion. The PNGs under assets/images/backgrounds/ named ground-*.png, paper-grain.png and leaf-fall.png are generated from the theme palette by tools/generate-backgrounds.php - re-run it after a re-skin.
